name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free app that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into narrated audio, all running on your own computer instead of a paid cloud service.
buyer: A YouTube creator, course maker, or audiobook publisher who currently pays a monthly subscription to a cloud voice service like ElevenLabs and wants the same result for free, privately.
business_use_cases: A course creator dubs their English video course into a dozen languages overnight on their own machine, then sells access to each localized version in that country's market.
An indie audiobook producer clones a narrator's voice (with consent) once and generates an entire back catalog of audiobooks without paying per-minute cloud fees.
A dubbing studio handling small clients runs it locally to quote jobs cheaper than competitors who pay per-character cloud TTS pricing, keeping client audio off third-party servers.

money_ideas.idea: Run a localized-video-dubbing service for YouTubers and course creators, charging per video or per language added.
Offer a managed/hosted version with a simple UI for non-technical creators who don't want to install or run it themselves.
Sell cloned-voice audiobook production as a one-off service to self-published authors who can't afford a human narrator.

steal_this: Offer a 'dub your YouTube backlog into 5 languages this weekend' package to a handful of mid-size creators, priced per video, using it as the whole production pipeline.
